definitions.explanation: Firmly held, secured, or established. Used for things that are reliably solid, like a firm handshake, solid defense, or secure promise.

definitions.gloss: strict; upright; serious; rigid in character
definitions.explanation: Describes a person or behavior that is strict, serious, principled, or inflexible. Can be positive (reliable, upright) or negative (stiff, uptight).

examples.japanese: {堅|かた}い⟦{握手|あくしゅ}→握手：01683_akushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
{堅|かた}い⟦{守|まも}り→守り：12250_mamori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失点|しってん}→失点：19150_shitten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}いだ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: A solid defense prevented them from scoring.

notes: One of three homophones all read かたい: ⟦{固|かた}い→固い：12090_katai⟧ (physically hard/solid, like frozen food), ⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧ (hard in texture/stiff, like a hard mattress), and {堅|かた}い (firm/reliable/strict, abstract qualities). {堅|かた}い focuses on firmness of character, reliability, and certainty. Key collocations: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{堅|かた}い (tight-lipped, able to keep secrets), {堅|かた}い⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧ (a safe/reliable business), ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{堅|かた}い (rigid/inflexible thinking), {堅|かた}い⟦{守|まも}り→守り：12250_mamori⟧ (solid defense). The expression {堅|かた}いこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ means 'to be strict/fussy about things.'
